subject: general
question: On 4 April 2025, which bank of India has launched a verified WhatsApp channel for Financial Updates?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **4 April 2025**, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) launched a verified **WhatsApp channel** to provide financial updates to the public.
 
• This initiative aims to enhance **communication and engagement** with the general public using a widely used messaging platform.
 
• The RBI's verified WhatsApp channel will offer updates on **policy changes, announcements, and financial literacy** topics.
 
• Subscribers to this channel will receive **real-time and authenticated information** directly from the RBI.
 
• This move reflects the RBI's efforts to leverage **digital platforms** for transparency and accessibility in financial communication.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI):**

 
 
• Established on **1 April 1935**, RBI is India's central banking institution.
 
• It regulates monetary policy and ensures **financial stability** in India.
 
• The RBI also oversees **currency issuance, foreign exchange management**, and banking operations.
 
 
 
• **WhatsApp Channels:**
 
 
• Introduced by WhatsApp, channels are a feature for **broadcasting information** to large audiences.
 
• Channels allow organizations to communicate with users in a **controlled and verified manner**.
 
 
 
• **Digital Communication in Banking:**
 
 
• Indian banks increasingly use **social media and digital platforms** for customer engagement.
 
• Such initiatives aim to improve **financial literacy and accessibility** for users.
 
 
 
• **Financial Updates:**
 
 
• Information shared through these channels includes **policy changes, interest rates, schemes, and global financial trends.**
 
• The goal is to ensure **timely dissemination of information** to the public.
